summary.text: Noel Frame is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 36, which she has represented since January 9, 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Jill England (R).
She previously served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2016 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Frame was born in Battle Ground, Washington, and lives in Greenwood, Washington.
She earned a B.A. in political communication and an M.A. in political management, both from The George Washington University in 2004.

Her career experience includes working as a legislative correspondent for U.S. Senator Maria Cantwell, a senior analyst for Lake Partners Strategy Consultants, a project manager, a communications and strategy consultant, and a director of policy and planning at BDS Planning & Urban Design.
Frame represented House District 36-Position 1 from 2016 to 2023, when Julia Reed (D) succeeded her, and succeeded Reuven Carlyle (D) in the Senate.
In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the Business, Financial Services & Trade and Housing committees.
